# Decisions

Rules that span modules, from each package's `Decisions:`. Owner rules end with `(owner)`.

## Owner

- `llmlm`: An unknown model's cost is null, never an estimate. (owner)
- `llmlm`: Every tool depends on the sibling checkout, editable, guarded by the consumer-test gate: `consumers.toml` names each tool and its test command; `tools/check-consumers.sh` runs them on the scripted tier in each tool's real venv before a push, which is the gate. CI runs the same script and reports only, because the runner lacks the tools' sibling packages and system tools. (owner)
- `llmlm`: One ledger format, one cap vocabulary (`[llm].max_usd_per_run`, `[llm].max_usd_per_day`), one price cache, for every tool. (owner)
- `llmlm`: The reply-cache key is byte for byte what corpuslm's was. Enforced by: tests/test_llm.py::test_the_cache_key_is_byte_for_byte_what_it_always_was. (owner)
- `llmlm`: llmlm is a library only; verbs live in the tools. Enforced by: pyproject.toml (no `[project.scripts]`). (owner)
- `llmlm.cast`: "of this book" in the reference text and the `authorlm:` prefix on stored fields are settings (`Settings.series`, `Settings.prefix`), so authorlm's existing images keep reading correctly. Enforced by: tests/test_cast.py::test_an_image_authorlm_wrote_before_the_move_still_reads. (owner)
- `llmlm.cast`: A render that names a character with no picked plate does not run text-only; it stops with every reason as a sentence. Enforced by: tests/test_cast.py::test_render_declines_text_only_when_a_named_character_has_no_plate. (owner)
- `llmlm.cast`: The cast code lives here and authorlm and musiclm both call it. Here: looking up a character's picked plate and reporting one that is missing or unpicked; the reference text sent with the plates; rendering N candidates with the plates attached; candidate file names and the hashes behind them; the fields stored inside each image file and reading them back; the pin file and the off-model mark. In the caller: finding its characters, its look rules, its description files, and its picks (authorlm: the embed line; musiclm: the request file). Why: musiclm's stills need the same likeness machinery authorlm's illustrations have, and two copies would drift. It never reads a manuscript: it works on a folder of images and the plain data it is handed. Enforced by: tests/test_cast.py::test_references_come_back_in_cast_order_then_the_prior_plate. (owner)
- `llmlm.picker`: The shared picking page lives here, beside `llmlm.cast`. Each app shows it on its own server and records the pick in its own way (musiclm: the request file; authorlm: the embed line). llmlm stays a library: no server, no command line, no new port. Enforced by: tests/test_picker.py::test_the_module_opens_no_file_but_its_own_static_assets. (owner)

## Agent-drafted

- `llmlm.cast`: Candidate names and their hashes are byte for byte what authorlm wrote before the move. Enforced by: tests/test_cast.py::test_the_hashes_are_what_authorlm_always_wrote.
- `llmlm.picker`: A held-back choice shows its sentence and stays pickable when it has candidates; the host offers none when nothing may be picked.
- `llmlm.picker`: A reply must name every choice of the page exactly once; one it leaves out is a problem, never "no picks". Why: a missing choice read as empty would erase a pick. A reply with any problem reads back with no picks at all.
- `llmlm.picker`: A single-pick choice may have no pick: tapping the picked candidate again removes it.
- `llmlm.picker`: Candidates are drawn ungrouped first, then each group in the order its label first appears, under the label as a heading. Why: current candidates come before those of an earlier brief.
- `llmlm.picker`: Candidates are one column below about 600 px of width and side by side above it; tapping an image opens it full size in a dialog with Previous, Next and the same Pick button.
- `llmlm.picker`: Save posts JSON, not a form: `{"token": text, "choices": [{"id", "picks": [file, ...], "note"}]}` with `Content-Type: application/json` plus the host's `post_headers`. Why: the order of several picks is a list, which a form flattens; the hosts' write check already wants JSON with an `X-<App>: 1` header; and a save that fails keeps every tap and note on the screen instead of reloading it. Without the script the page still shows the current picks, read-only.
- `llmlm.picker`: The host answers a save with any 2xx when it recorded the reply, optionally a JSON object with `message` (shown after "Saved") and `token` (the next save sends it back); otherwise a non-2xx with `{"problems": [sentence, ...]}` or `{"error": sentence}`, shown after "Not saved".
- `llmlm.picker`: The page carries no inline script, no `style` element or attribute and no handler attribute, and every URL in it is a path on the host (one leading `/`), so it runs under `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'` and makes no outside request. A page that would break this is declined (`PickerError`) with each reason. Enforced by: tests/test_picker.py::test_the_page_carries_no_inline_script_no_style_and_no_handler_attribute.
- `llmlm.picker`: The texts the script writes (the status line, the picked line) are in `static/picker.js`; the page is in English.
- `llmlm.picker`: `token` is the host's own text (a file hash, a version), sent back unchanged with every save, so the host can decline a save made on a stale page. The picker never reads it.
